arxiv-2407-15504.title: Fundamental Limits of Prompt Compression: A Rate-Distortion Framework for Black-Box Language Models
arxiv-2407-15504.creator: Alliot Nagle * UT Austin, Adway GirishEPFL, Marco BondaschiEPFL, Michael GastparEPFL, Ashok Vardhan MakkuvaEPFL, Hyeji KimUT Austin
arxiv-2407-15504.description: Abstract We formalize the problem of prompt compression for large language models (LLMs) and present a framework to unify token-level prompt compression methods which create hard prompts for black-box models. We derive the distortion-rate function for this setup as a linear program, and provide an efficient algorithm to compute this fundamental limit via the dual of the linear program.

arxiv-2407-18262.title: Solar activity and extreme rainfall over Kerala, India
arxiv-2407-18262.creator: Elizabeth Thomas 1, S. Vineeth 1 and Noble P. Abraham 1,*
arxiv-2407-18262.description: Abstract This paper examines the relationship between solar activity and extreme rainfall events in Kerala, India. Kerala receives minimum and maximum rainfall during winter and monsoon seasons. Sunspot number, F10.7 Index, and cosmic ray intensity are the solar indices considered, and their variations with rainfall are studied over 57 years (1965-2021), i.e., starting from Solar Cycle 20.

arxiv-2412-01297.title: Morphological-Symmetry-Equivariant Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network for Robotic Dynamics Learning
arxiv-2412-01297.creator: Fengze Xie, Sizhe Wei, Yue Song, Yisong Yue, Lu Gan
arxiv-2412-01297.description: Abstract We propose MS-HGNN, a Morphological-Symmetry-Equivariant Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network for robotic dynamics learning, which integrates robotic kinematic structures and morphological symmetries into a unified graph network. By embedding these structural priors as inductive biases, MS-HGNN ensures high generalizability, sample and model efficiency. This architecture is versatile and broadly applicable to various multi-body dynamic systems and dynamics learning tasks.

arxiv-2506-12329.title: Multi-state detection and spatial addressing in a microscope for ultracold molecules
arxiv-2506-12329.creator: Jonathan M. Mortlock, Adarsh P. Raghuram, Benjamin P. Maddox, Philip D. Gregory, Simon L. Cornish
arxiv-2506-12329.description: Abstract Precise measurement of the particle number, spatial distribution and internal state is fundamental to all proposed experiments with ultracold molecules both in bulk gases and optical lattices. Here, we demonstrate in-situ detection of individual molecules in a bulk sample of 87 Rb 133 Cs molecules.

arxiv-2511-20081.description: Abstract Chemical Exchange Saturation Transfer (CEST) MRI enables molecular-level visualization of low-concentration metabolites by leveraging proton exchange dynamics. However, its clinical translation is hindered by inherent challenges: spatially varying noise arising from hardware limitations, and complex imaging protocols introduce heteroscedasticity in CEST data, perturbing the accuracy of quantitative contrast mapping such as amide proton transfer (APT) imaging.

pmc-12461177.creator: Youngsoo Shin, Elizabeth Borycki, Carla M D S Freitas, Kassu Jilcha Sileyew
pmc-12461177.description: BackgroundAs information and communication technologies and artificial intelligence (AI) become deeply integrated into daily life, the focus on users’ digital well-being has grown across academic and industrial fields. pmc-12472807.title: Effect and Mechanism of Qihua Tongtiao Formula (QHTTF) on Improving Glucose and Lipid Metabolism Disorders in ZDF Rats by Integrating Network Pharmacology, Metabolomics, and Biological Validation
pmc-12472807.creator: Yuhua Jiang, Hong Yu, Yajing Pan, Binghan Zhang, Yeteng Jing, Jingjing Lei, Ning Li, Jinsheng Yang
pmc-12472807.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: The dysregulation of both glucose and lipid metabolism is the main clinical features of type 2 diabetes. Qihua Tongtiao Formula (QHTTF) is our team’s current clinical empirical formula, and the related patent has been granted. It is composed of Astragalus membranaceus, Atractylodes macrocephala koidz, Aurantii Fructus Immaturus, Radix Bupleuri, Ligusticum chuanxiong hort, Angelicae sinensis radix, Raphanus sativus, and Polyporus umbellatus. It can alleviate tissue pathological damage in type 2 diabetic rats by improving glycolipid metabolism disorders.

pmc-12590804.title: Unexplained infertility’s determinants, correlation with bacterial vaginosis and anti-sperm antibodies among Congolese women: a case‒control study
pmc-12590804.creator: Mike-Antoine Maindo Alongo, Jean-Jeanntot Juakali Sihalikyolo, Salomon Batina Agasa, Noël Labama Otuli, Sarah Missimbu Mayindu, Bienvenu Antony Ilongosi, Louise Bamawa Bahaisi, Gédeon Katenga Bosunga
pmc-12590804.description: IntroductionUnexplained infertility (UI) affects 15–30% of infertile couples. This can be a very distressing experience for couples and challenging for clinicians because the diagnostic evidence is still weak. This study aimed to determine the risk factors for UI and its correlation with both bacterial vaginosis (BV) and anti-sperm antibodies (ASAs) among Congolese women.

pmc-12966184.creator: Manabu Hoshi, Masanari Aono, Yoshitaka Ban
pmc-12966184.description: IntroductionOsteochondroma or exostosis is the most common benign bone tumor and is typically diagnosed based on its characteristic radiographic features. While it is generally familiar to orthopaedic surgeons, the level of diagnostic familiarity among primary physicians remains unclear.Materials and methodsThis retrospective study reviewed 195 patients diagnosed with osteochondroma/exostosis who were referred to a tertiary orthopaedic oncology center.

pmc-13700208.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic was a prolonged period of traumatic stress with potentially lasting health impacts, especially for vulnerable groups including pregnant individuals.
